text:
lucy: deploy-bot raised a post-deploy metadata mismatch: released image tag v5.1.0 but release-notes reference v5.0.7. deploybot flagged possible docs/regression risk and suggested autorevert.

deploy-bot: ALERT: release-metadata-mismatch | image_tag=v5.1.0 | release_notes_tag=v5.0.7 | confidence=HIGH | action=AUTOREVERT_SUGGESTED

release-manager: uhoh. this is likely a release-note publish failure, not a code bug. we can't autorevert without confirming behavioral regression. who is oncall for docs/release?

marco: i'm awake, can look. logs show post-release job failed to publish notes due to perms error. no telemetry regressions.

legal-bot: NOTE: if release notes mention feature flags removed, we must notify compliance. current mismatch seems only version number. no legal exposure.

ops-bot: POLICY: Auto-revert triggers on certain metadata mismatches when detected during change window. Humans can set a hold: `deploybot.hold=true` to suppress.

lucy: i'll set hold and fix the release notes. setting `deploybot.hold=true` now.
deploy-bot: LOG: hold set by lucy at 4474002230; autorevert suppressed.

release-manager: plan: 1) publish corrected release notes 2) run smoke tests 3) unset hold once smoke ok 4) short customer comm if any ambiguity.

marco: publishing notes now -> `ci release:publish --tag v5.1.0 --notes-file notes/v5.1.0.md` returned 0. smoke tests passing. p95 and error rate unchanged.

release-manager: posted corrected notes to #release-notes-drafts and added audit log. posting short customer blurb: "Minor docs sync: release notes for v5.1.0 were updated for accuracy. No service impact."

lucy: unsetting hold at 4474002258 -> `deploybot.hold=false`. deploy-bot: hold cleared; autorevert re-enabled for future windows.

deploy-bot: LOG: No autorevert executed. Reason: human hold prevented auto action; manual remediation completed.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: since this was metadata-only, no incident required. add follow-up ticket DOCS-142 to fix CI perms and add guard to prevent autorevert for docs-only mismatches.

release-manager: assigning DOCS-142 to infra-sre. closing thread. if deploy-bot flags similar mismatch next time, escalate to oncall immediately.
